_about: Documented physical / environment FACTS for the redox-screening project. Single machine-readable source of truth. config/electrolyte.py loads this and exposes the names the pipeline imports. Edit values HERE, not in code.

solvent.name: acetonitrile
solvent._notes: eps_r = static (relative) permittivity. eps_optical = n_D^2 (MeCN n_D = 1.344 at 20 C -> 1.806). Pekar factor (1/eps_optical - 1/eps_r) feeds the Marcus/Born outer-sphere reorganization energy, Sharma et al. PNAS 2021 Eq. 12-13. solvent_probe_radius_A = effective radius of one MeCN molecule (vdW volume ~45 A^3), used as the SASA probe when estimating the hydrodynamic radius r_hyd of a solute (roll a solvent-sized probe over the solute -> solvent-accessible surface -> equivalent-sphere radius).

reference._notes: E_vs_Fc = E_abs - E_ref_abs. Prefer fc_abs_computed_V (our level-matched ferrocene). fc_abs_ref_MeCN_V are published OROP SI values for cross-check. Fc/Fc+ vs SCE in MeCN = +0.40 V (Pavlishchuk & Addison 2000), used to convert vs-SCE literature anchors.
